kind_of_thing.quote: A truck (North American and Australian English) or lorry (British English) is a motor vehicle designed to transport freight, carry specialized payloads, or perform other utilitarian work.

kind_of_made_thing.quote: A truck (or lorry in British English) is a motor vehicle used to transport cargo, goods, materials, or troops.

where_it_travels.why: A truck is a motor vehicle that carries goods on roads, as when the source says the road spreads the truck's weight.
